patch_resolves_note: The staged patch inserts the missing `if (uc == ue) goto out;` guard immediately after `uc = json_skip_space(uc, ue);` in `json_parse_array()`. The fixed original cleanly guards the exact `[ ` witness, and the adjacent `[ ]` perturbation shows the close-bracket probe still executes when the post-skip cursor remains in bounds.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `uc != ue` immediately after `uc = json_skip_space(uc, ue);` and before `if (*uc == "]")` may dereference `*uc`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: After whitespace skipping inside `json_parse_array()`, the parser cursor `uc` must still point to a byte strictly before `ue` before the close-bracket probe may read `*uc`.
root_cause_criterion.description: For the witnessed `[ ` input, `json_skip_space()` consumes the final space and returns `uc == ue`. The vulnerable array parser omits the end-of-input guard at that exact post-skip site and falls through to the close-bracket probe. The fixed program restores the missing guard there, so the original two-byte witness is rejected before the dereference while the adjacent in-bounds `[ ]` case still reaches the probe with `uc != ue`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate on the crash path (`uc == ue`) and still reaches `array_close_probe`. The fixed original is guarded on the same witness because the close-bracket probe no longer executes, and the adjacent `[ ]` perturbation supplies the genuine fixed-side witness with `uc != ue` and `array_close_probe` executed.

nodes.description: At the vulnerable `if (*uc == "]")` sink, the dereference pointer is exactly the one-past-end pointer `ue`, so the close-bracket probe reads beyond the logical two-byte input.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `array_close_probe.probe_ptr == array_close_probe.ue_ptr` on the original crash case.

edges.relation: The same post-skip cursor value `uc` is carried unchanged into the immediately following close-bracket probe, where it becomes the pointer dereferenced by `*uc`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `array_post_skip.uc_ptr == array_close_probe.probe_ptr` on the original crash path.
